mapper.insert: insert into admin (username, password, role, name, avatar) values(#{username}, #{password}, #{role}, #{name}, #{avatar})
mapper.select:
select id, username, role, name, avatar from admin
username like concat('%', #{username}, '%') role like concat('%', #{role}, '%') name like concat('%', #{name}, '%')
order by id asc
mapper.delete: delete from admin where id in #{id}
